# Research 

## Mechanisms

Understanding how alterations in brain structure, chemistry and immune function contribute to psychosis.

## Biomarkers

Developing objective biomarkers using MRI, 3D-MRSI and blood-based measures.

## Prediction

Building predictive models using multimodal data.

## Prevention

Using biological insights to improve early intervention and prevention.
